title: My data: the starting screen
intro: My data is the first tab of the group Your data. It is where the weather and the soil of the site are set once; Scenarios, Experiments and Processes all read them from here. With nothing changed, the built-in weather of Taastrup and the built-in loam and sand are used.

marks.d: Where the weather comes from: the built-in weather, the weather of the SWAFL project, online weather of a place, or a file of your own.
A summary of the weather that will be used: its name, years, mean rain and mean temperature, and the checks that were made.
Tick to describe your own soil horizons instead of the two built-in soils.
